Jordan: pushing hotfix v2.3.1 to prod EU1 now — embed.read returns 502s in prod. Need expedited approval to pin canary & skip 30m hold. deploy job: deploy-31415
Deploy-bot: deployment requested: job=deploy-31415, target=prod.eu1, image=redwood-inference:v2.3.1, canary=10% -> pin requested by @Jordan
Rebecca: what's the rollback plan? if metrics don't look good we should auto-roll to v2.3.0
Jordan: rollback: manual rollback script ready (scripts/rollback_to_2_3_0.sh) — can trigger via `/ops rollback deploy-31415`
Morgan: @Ops-oncall can you take the SLA exception? We'll need a fast signoff :warning:
Ops-oncall: I can approve as long as we keep 5% canary for first 5m and metric watches on embed_latency/error_rate. +1
Carla: can someone add the release notes link here? QA needs the changelog for post-deploy smoke runs
Jordan: release notes: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2.3.1 — doc has impact, telemetry checks, and rollback steps
Deploy-bot: canary started: job=deploy-31415, canary=10% -> observing metrics (latency, error_rate, cpu). Status: collecting
Deploy-bot: canary health update (5m): latency + errors within threshold, no spike in memory. suggested action: pin if approvals present
Rebecca: QA ran smoke against canary endpoints, all green :white_check_mark: happy to approve pin to 100%
Morgan: +1 from me, tagging compliance for a quick read: @Lena
Lena: quick scan complete: no data-privacy impact, compliance OK. no blockers
Jordan: proceeding to pin canary -> rolling to 100% now (pin-by: Rebecca, Morgan, Ops-oncall) :rocket:
Deploy-bot: rolling canary -> 100%. final health check in progress
Deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: job=deploy-31415, status=SUCCESS, finished=1717171970
Jordan: rolled forward to v2.3.1 in prod EU1. Monitoring dashboards up, alerted on embed_error_rate > 0.5%. Will watch next 30m and open incident if anomalies. Thanks everyone for quick approvals :thumbsup:
